# Shelf reading schedule

Shelf reading means walking the stacks and putting books back in call number order. Each branch reads its adult nonfiction once a month and its children's room every two weeks.

| Branch | Day |
| --- | --- |
| Main Street | First Tuesday |
| Pinecrest | Second Wednesday |
| Millbrook | Second Thursday |
| Harlow Junction | Third Monday |
| Eastgate | Fourth Tuesday |

Pages record the sections they finished on the sheet in the workroom. Report missing items so they can be searched for and, after two searches, marked missing.
